entries.question: I want to check the lab report but the site is not working tell me other method to check the report
entries.answer:
If the KGMU website is not responding, you can try the following methods to access your lab reports:

1.  **Contact the Department Directly:** You can check the [KGMU IP Phone Directory](https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php) to find the contact number for the specific department (e.g., Pathology, Microbiology) where your tests were conducted.
2.  **Visit the Department:** If you are in or near Lucknow, the most reliable method is to visit the concerned department's collection or report dispatch counter in person. Please carry your original OPD registration slip or test receipt.
3.  **PRO Office Assistance:** If you are unable to reach the department, you may contact the Public Relations Officer (PRO) office for guidance. You can find the relevant contact numbers here: [https://kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php](https://kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php).
4.  **Patient Welfare Office:** For assistance related to patient services, you can reach out to the Patient Welfare Office, particularly if your tests were done at the Trauma Centre (Phone: 08887019133).

**Important Safety Note:** Please do not share your personal identification numbers, patient IDs, or contact details in this chat. When calling or visiting, ensure you are speaking with official university personnel.

entries.question: Appoinment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

*   **Online (ORS):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, and follow the steps to book your appointment.
*   **Mobile App:** You can use the ABHA/Health Care App to register and book your slot.
*   **SMS:** Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital in person. Please bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to generate an OTP for a physical token.

**Important Information:**
*   **Registration Fee:** There is a mandatory fee of ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open Monday–Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you bring a valid referral for the specific department.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.

If you have specific medical concerns, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD. For further assistance, you can call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: मेरे पिताजी का कार्डियो लगी डिपार्टमेंट में सर्जरी हुई उन्हें दो स्टंट पड़े हैं
entries.answer:
यह जानकर अच्छा लगा कि आपके पिताजी की सर्जरी सफल रही।

मैं एक AI हूँ और चिकित्सा संबंधी सलाह नहीं दे सकता। आपके पिताजी की रिकवरी के लिए कृपया निम्नलिखित बातों का ध्यान रखें:

1. **डॉक्टर के निर्देशों का पालन करें:** डिस्चार्ज के समय अस्पताल से मिली दवाइयों की सूची और निर्देशों का सख्ती से पालन करें।
2. **फॉलो-अप (Follow-up):** कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग द्वारा दी गई अगली जांच (check-up) की तारीख पर जरूर जाएं।
3. **आपातकालीन स्थिति:** यदि उन्हें छाती में दर्द, सांस लेने में तकलीफ, अत्यधिक कमजोरी, या टांके वाली जगह पर सूजन/लालपन महसूस हो, तो तुरंत **KGMU के कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग (LARI Cardiology)** या आपातकालीन सेवा (Emergency) से संपर्क करें। 
4. **संपर्क:** किसी भी शंका के लिए आप कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग के कार्यालय या हेल्प लाइन (0522-2258880) पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

उनके शीघ्र स्वस्थ होने की कामना करता हूँ। क्या आप किसी विशेष विभाग के संपर्क नंबर या किसी अन्य जानकारी के बारे में जानना चाहते हैं?

entries.question: सामान्य सुझाव एवं परामर्श हेतु कांटेक्ट नंबर उपलब्ध करावे
entries.answer:
सामान्य सुझाव, परामर्श या किसी भी प्रकार की सहायता के लिए आप KGMU के निम्नलिखित आधिकारिक नंबरों पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं:

*   **KGMU हेल्प लाइन (General Helpline):** 0522-2258880 या 0522-3539333
*   **LARI कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग (PRO Office):** 9415099528
*   **कुलपति कार्यालय (VC Office):** 0522-2257540
*   **कुलसचिव कार्यालय (Registrar Office):** 0522-2253171

**कुछ महत्वपूर्ण सुझाव:**
1. **OPD परामर्श:** यदि आपको डॉक्टर से परामर्श लेना है, तो ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) के माध्यम से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
2. **आपातकालीन स्थिति:** यदि स्थिति गंभीर है, तो कृपया सीधे KGMU के **ट्रॉमा सेंटर (Trauma Centre)** या कार्डियोलॉजी इमरजेंसी में जाएं।
3. **व्यक्तिगत जानकारी:** सुरक्षा के लिए, कृपया इस चैट में अपने पिताजी का नाम, मोबाइल नंबर, या कोई भी संवेदनशील मेडिकल रिपोर्ट साझा न करें।

क्या आप किसी विशिष्ट विभाग या सेवा के बारे में और जानकारी चाहते हैं?

entries.question: How can i book my opd appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, you have several options. Please note that online registration is mandatory for all patients.

### **Available Booking Methods**
1.  **Online Registration System (ORS):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Follow the prompts to select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, choose your department and date, enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your appointment slip.
2.  **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection process as the ORS portal.
3.  **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** You can visit the hospital directly. Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP, collect a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and receive your OPD slip.

### **Important Information**
*   **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** The ticket/parchi counter closes at **1:00 PM sharp**.
*   **Referral:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for the specific department.
*   **Advice:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.
*   **Helpline:** If you need assistance, you can call 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.

*Note: I am an AI, not a doctor. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, please proceed directly to the Trauma Centre (Gate 14).*

entries.question: How To Raise A Complain
entries.answer:
To raise a formal complaint regarding your experience at KGMU, you can use the following channels:

*   **Patient Welfare Office (Trauma Centre):** For immediate concerns regarding patient care, you can visit or call the Patient Welfare Office at the Trauma Centre at **8887019133**.
*   **CMO/ADO Office:** For clinical delays or grievances at the Trauma Centre, contact the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) or Assistant Duty Officer (ADO) at **8004849905**.
*   **PRO Office:** You may contact the Public Relations Office (PRO) for general grievances. The contact numbers are available at: [https://kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php](https://kgmu.org/imp_numbers.php).
*   **University Helpline:** You can call the main KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** for guidance on the grievance process.
*   **Official Website:** You can check the [Official Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) or the [RTI/Public Information Officer page](https://kgmu.org/rti.php) if you wish to file a formal request for information or a written grievance.

Please ensure you have the patient's registration number or relevant hospital documentation ready when speaking to the administration. For your safety, do not share any personal details or specific patient information in this chat.

entries.question: Mujhe neurology mein appointment chahie
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Neurology OPD ke liye online registration anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap niche diye gaye tarikon se appointment book kar sakte hain:

1.  **Online Booking (ORS):** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par login/register karein, phir Uttar Pradesh -> KGMU select karke Neurology department aur date chunein.
2.  **Mobile App:** ABHA/Health Care App ka upyog karke bhi aap appointment le sakte hain.
3.  **SMS:** Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar 8887019134 par bhejein.
4.  **Walk-in:** Aap seedhe KGMU bhi ja sakte hain, lekin iske liye apna **Aadhaar card** aur **active mobile number** saath rakhein. Token lene ke baad ₹50 ka OPD slip katwana hoga.

**Kuch Zaruri Baatein:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Somwar se Shukrawar: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Shanivar: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Ravivar ko band rehta hai).
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se hain, toh kripya sambandhit department ka valid referral letter saath layein.
*   **Wait Time:** Bheed se bachne ke liye pehle se booking (pre-booking) karna behtar hai. Parchi counter 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai.

Main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye kisi bhi tarah ki medical advice ya treatment ke liye kripya KGMU ke doctor se sampark karein. Apni suraksha ke liye chat mein apna Aadhaar number ya koi bhi personal health record share na karein.

entries.question: Cardiology department
entries.answer:
The Cardiology department at KGMU is a specialized center for heart care. You can find detailed information about the department, its faculty, and services at the official link below:

[Cardiology Department - KGMU](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=9&dept_type=2)

**Key Information:**
*   **Emergency:** In case of a cardiac emergency, please proceed to the Trauma Centre first for stabilization, after which patients are transferred to the LARI Cardiology department.
*   **PRO Office (Lari Cardiology):** 9415099528
*   **OPD Appointments:** Online registration is mandatory via [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
*   **Location:** The Cardiology facilities are located along the Shah Mina Road belt.

If you have a specific question about a faculty member or a service, please let me know.

entries.question: Best doctor
entries.answer:
I cannot recommend a "best" doctor, as all faculty members at KGMU are highly qualified specialists in their respective fields. You can view the full list of faculty members, their qualifications, and their specializations for every department on the official KGMU website:

[KGMU Departments](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php)

If you are looking for a doctor for a specific condition, I recommend:
1.  **Checking the Department Page:** Visit the link above, select the relevant department, and review the faculty profiles to see their specific areas of expertise.
2.  **Consulting an OPD:** For medical concerns, please book an appointment through [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) to consult with a specialist at the KGMU OPD.

If you have a specific department or medical specialty in mind, I can provide you with the list of its faculty members from my records.
